summary: Drill result: 'P-301 hive-git drill: PASS=15 FAIL=0 SKIP=0 / OVERALL: PASS — release acceptance green; all Phase-3 legs ran with zero skips / DRILL_EXIT=0'. The deb under test was sha256-matched to the 0.0.25 release handoff before launch (expect == actual), and the macOS VM peer reported app version 0.0.25. The same-run physical evidence (runId above) carries pass verdicts for legs A-G at scope 'physical' across two physical machines, each signed by both host device keys, and the drill's SKIP census accepted it for LEG E (P-306 GitHub bridge: bridged-mode, commit-only members, sole egress, OID chain, watchdog, divergence, rollback) and LEG G (P-308 chaos: A-F then election, higher grant, successor accept, stale fence, retry hold, PG blip, restart). SCOPE OF THIS RECORD: it proves R-1's physical-peer hive-git behaviours (discovery/join via cold-clone + announce-driven fetch, exact signed-ref scope/generation with tamper/rollback refusal, integrator publication with below-steer queueing, gc/secret/oversized-blob guards, GitHub bridge, restart/PG-blip recovery) on the exact candidate. Leg G also proves protected-effect fencing at the canonical-staging sink (a device-only advance without hive authority and a stale-epoch replay are both refused with the receiver ref unchanged; the hive-authorized successor is accepted). It does NOT by itself prove R-1's F1-F8 feature set, separate optional packs, full installer lineage beyond the Server deb checksum and VM app version, trusted delegated-seat boot/work/receipts/stop/revocation, or the rest of the P-517 protected-effect set (release promotion, external canonical push and automatic fork/PR refusal on the non-owner, owner-outage freeze with no automatic takeover, and resume on restore); those need their own evidence. Note: the outer launcher wrapper was SIGKILLed after DRILL_EXIT=0 was printed, so the log has no LAUNCHER_EXIT line; the drill script itself exited 0.
